title: First Movement
subtitle: Make the rover drive
description: Get the rover moving along Sector 1 and reach the marked checkpoint.
story: Storm damage has cut power to Sector 1. Command needs a rover on the ground before dark. Your job today is simple: get it moving, get it round the corner, and get it to the checkpoint without wrecking it.
learningObjectives: A motor turns electrical energy into movement
Direction and speed are separate ideas
Rules are checked from the top of the list downwards
More motor power costs a lot more energy

objectives.description: Reach the checkpoint at the top of Sector 1
Bonus: finish with more than 50% battery left

failureConditions.message: The battery ran flat before the rover reached the checkpoint.
Time ran out before the rover reached the checkpoint.
The rover crashed too many times and was recalled for repairs.

hints: Your starter program only says 'Always → Drive forward'. The rover will drive straight into the wall at the corner.
Add a rule ABOVE 'Drive forward': when the distance sensor is less than 1, turn left.
Rules are checked top to bottom, and the first one that matches wins. Order matters.
Try lowering motor power to about 60%. You lose very little speed but save a lot of energy.
reflectionQuestions: What happened the first time you pressed Run, and why?
Where did you place your turning rule in the list, and why does that position matter?
What happened to your score when you changed the motor power?
